transcript:
[SFX:He switches phones to the mobile one we heard Judith and David on.]

MARTIN (CONT’D): H-Hello?

We hear a distant evil chuckle from David. A very sinister laugh. 

DAVID: You think you can escape?

The phone cuts off dead.

MARTIN (CONT’D): Oh God.

DAVID (Distant on the land line):  Martin? What the hell? Where are you?

Martin picks up the land line again.
